name: io.github.guiomatos/glowmap
title: GlowMap — Personal Color Analysis
description: 12-season personal color analysis test, hex palettes, and photo calibration links (EN & PT-BR).

tools.name: get_color_quiz
tools.description: Returns the 7 official personal color analysis questions with valid option IDs so the assistant can interview the user before calling run_color_analysis.

lang.description: Output language: 'en' (English, glowmap.me) or 'pt' (Portuguese, glowmap.me/br). Defaults to the server host language.

tools.name: run_color_analysis
tools.description: Classifies the user's preliminary season among the 12 seasons from their 7 quiz answers and returns a pre-filled calibration URL so they only need to take 1 white-paper photo on their phone.

pele.description: How would you describe your skin depth? / Como você descreveria sua pele? Options: muito_clara = Very fair (Muito clara); clara = Fair / Light (Clara); media = Medium (Média); morena = Tan / Olive-medium (Morena); escura = Deep / Dark (Escura); retinta = Very deep / Rich dark (Retinta).

veias.description: Look at the veins on your inner wrist in natural daylight. They look… / Olhe as veias do pulso, perto da luz do dia. Elas parecem… Options: verdes = Green or olive (Verdes ou oliva); azuis = Blue or purple (Azuis ou roxas); mistura = A mix / hard to tell (Uma mistura / não sei).

metal.description: Which jewelry metal makes your skin look healthier? / Qual joia te deixa com cara mais saudável? Options: ouro = Gold (Dourada); prata = Silver (Prateada); ambos = Both look good (As duas ficam bem).

branco.description: Next to your face, which white looks better? / Perto do rosto, o que fica melhor? Options: branco = Crisp pure white (Branco puro (gelo)); creme = Off-white, cream, or ivory (Off-white (creme, marfim)); ambos = About the same (Tanto faz).

sol.description: In the sun without sunscreen, your skin usually… / No sol, sem protetor, sua pele… Options: queima = Burns pink/red and barely tans (Fica vermelha e quase não bronzeia); bronzeia = Tans easily into a golden tone (Bronzeia fácil, dourada); pouco = Barely changes (Quase não muda).

cabelo.description: What is your NATURAL hair color (at the roots, undyed)? / Qual a cor NATURAL do seu cabelo (raiz, sem tinta)? Options: loiro_claro = Light blonde (Loiro claro); loiro_escuro = Dark blonde / light brown (Loiro escuro / castanho claro); ruivo = Red / auburn / copper (Ruivo / acobreado); castanho_medio = Medium brown (Castanho médio); castanho_escuro = Dark brown (Castanho escuro); preto = Black (Preto); grisalho = Gray / silver / white (Grisalho / branco).

olhos.description: And your eye color? / E seus olhos? Options: claros = Blue, green, or gray (Azuis, verdes ou cinza); mel = Hazel or amber (Mel ou âmbar); castanho_claro = Light brown (Castanho claro); castanho_escuro = Dark brown or black (Castanho escuro ou preto).

client.description: Optional calling assistant name (e.g., claude, chatgpt, cursor) for attribution.

lang.description: Output language: 'en' (English, glowmap.me) or 'pt' (Portuguese, glowmap.me/br). Defaults to the server host language.

tools.name: list_seasons
tools.description: Lists all 12 expanded color seasons with family, summary, best jewelry metal, and guide URLs. Optionally filter by family.

family.description: Optional family filter: Spring/Primavera, Summer/Verão, Autumn/Outono, or Winter/Inverno.

lang.description: Output language: 'en' (English, glowmap.me) or 'pt' (Portuguese, glowmap.me/br). Defaults to the server host language.

tools.name: get_season_details
tools.description: Returns the 10-color hex palette, 4 colors to avoid near the face, jewelry metal, and lip/blush/eye/hair/outfit tips for any of the 12 seasons.

season.description: Season name or slug in English or Portuguese (e.g., 'Warm Autumn', 'True Autumn', 'deep-winter', 'Outono Quente').

lang.description: Output language: 'en' (English, glowmap.me) or 'pt' (Portuguese, glowmap.me/br). Defaults to the server host language.

tools.name: recommend_products
tools.description: Queries GlowMap's active makeup catalog (currently curated for Brazil / Mercado Livre) filtered by season, category, skin depth, and undertone.

season.description: Season name or slug (e.g., 'Warm Autumn', 'Outono Quente', 'deep-winter').

depth.description: Skin depth (required to include base, corretivo, or po).

undertone.description: Skin undertone (required to include base, corretivo, or po).

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (default: 6).

lang.description: Output language: 'en' (English, glowmap.me) or 'pt' (Portuguese, glowmap.me/br). Defaults to the server host language.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Searches GlowMap's educational guides on color analysis, undertones, contrast, makeup, and the 12 seasons.

query.description: Search query in English or Portuguese (e.g., 'olive skin', 'gold vs silver', 'subtom de pele').

lang.description: Output language: 'en' (English, glowmap.me) or 'pt' (Portuguese, glowmap.me/br). Defaults to the server host language.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Returns the full Markdown content of any GlowMap guide by slug or path (e.g., 'skin-undertone-test', '/seasons/warm-autumn', 'subtom-de-pele').

lang.description: Output language: 'en' (English, glowmap.me) or 'pt' (Portuguese, glowmap.me/br). Defaults to the server host language.
